sections.title: Introduction
sections.text:
Infernal Shrines is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Diablo universe.
The signature Objective of this Map are Shrines. When active, each team
has to kill 40 Guardians. The first team who does that gets a Punisher,
a powerful unit that will enable a strong push.

sections.title: Lane Assignments
sections.text:
Here you can find one or more formations
that are viable on this Map. Keep in mind that positions in lane
are not strict and will often change based on the situation.

sections.title: Formation 1-4
Map Strategy
sections.text:
At 0:30 minutes or whenever available, start clearing the allied Siege Camp
in the middle lane and capture it as soon as possible. Watch out for invades!
Someone should stay in the bush on the side, so that you can react faster
when enemy Heroes arrive.
After that, if your team has an advantage,
start clearing the neutral Siege Camp in the bottom lane
and capture it as soon as possible.
At 2:15 minutes or 30-40 seconds before the next Objective phase,
start clearing the allied Bruiser Camp
and capture it slightly before the Shrine activates.
To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane together with allied Minions,
capture it at 2:40 minutes or 10 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned.
At 3:00 minutes or right before the next Shrine activates, you must be
already near the Shrine! Being late by just 5 seconds is enough to gift
10 Guardians to the enemy team. If you are 10 seconds late, the enemy team
can easily get a lead of 20 Guardians and basically get a free Punisher.
If it is the first Shrine of the game, the Offlaner
can double soak during the Objective phase
and while the Punisher is up. When the Objective is bottom,
they should rotate between the middle and the top lane. When the Objective
is middle or top, they should rotate between the middle and bottom lane.
If you win the Objective, push together with
the Punisher. The first thing you should do is to destroy
a Side Wall (on the external side of the Towers surrounding the Gate)
so that your team can use that space to make aggressive plays
and/or to get out when caught by enemy Heroes.
If you lose the Objective, fall back and kill the Punisher
as quickly as possible without dying. Do not try to save
Structures that have low Health as that will only give
the enemy team an opportunity to dive.

sections.title: Mercenary Camps
Siege Camp
sections.text:
This type of Mercenary Camp features 3 Impalers. Once captured,
it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane.
When possible, push with them to get more value.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
0:30 minutes
3:00 minutes after its last capture
Baseline Experience
Experience Scaling
270 Experience
+6 Experience per minute (*)
(*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute.
Impalers are ranged units that can attack enemies from the distance but lack
area of effect damage to quickly clear enemy Minions.
Once captured, they are capable of damaging enemy Structures without getting in their range.

sections.title: Bruiser Camp
sections.text:
This type of Mercenary Camp features 1 Fallen Shaman and 2 Fallen Hounds. Once captured,
it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane.
When possible, push with them to get more value.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
0:30 minutes
4:00 minutes after its last capture
Baseline Experience
Experience Scaling
450 Experience
+6 Experience per minute (*)
(*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute.
Once captured, the Fallen Shaman periodically summons 2 Fallen Hounds
whenever they die. The most efficient way to clear them in lane is therefore
to kill the Fallen Shaman first and the Fallen Hounds after. Fallen Shaman and
Fallen Hounds deal 100% increased damage to Minions, Structures and Summons.

sections.title: Map Objective
sections.text:
The signature Objective of Infernal Shrines are Shrines. When active, each team
has to kill 40 Guardians. The first team who does that gets a Punisher,
a powerful unit that will enable a strong push.
Shrines also spawn 2 Regeneration Globes when completed.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
3:00 minutes
3:00 minutes after the Punisher dies

Activate the Shrines
The Infernal Shrines periodically gather power. Activate them and prepare for a fight.
Defeat Guardians
Slay 40 Guardians before the enemy team to bring forth a mighty Punisher.
Beware the Punisher
Punishers have one of three devastating powers. Be careful, they focus on attacking heroes above all else.

sections.title: Shrines
sections.text:
Shrines can be in 3 different locations: right above the top lane,
right above the middle lane, and between the middle and the bottom lanes.
99% of the time, the Shrine will be in a different location from the previous one.
Guardians have 20 Spell Armor
and spawn in intervals of 0.15 seconds, until 10 of them exist.
From that point, a 5-second timer starts, which triggers another spawn phase.
Guardians follow enemies to attack them, so you can group them by moving around
and then use area of effect Abilities to kill
many of them at the same time. When doing so, be careful because enemy Heroes
will try to steal them by last-hitting! You should try to do the same.
The best Heroes for clearing the Shrine are:
Alexstrasza with Dragonqueen;
D.Va with a well-timed Self-Destruct;
Hogger with a well-placed Hogg Wild;
Tychus with Commandeer Odin.

sections.title: Punishers
sections.text:
The type of Punisher will change every time, across 3 different types:
Arcane (purple), placing rotating Arcane beams to damage enemies;
Frost (blue), firing delayed frost bombs that Root enemies and disable Structures;
Mortar (orange), launching a stream of firebombs to damage enemies.
Punishers can jump on enemy Gates and Heroes, dealing damage and
Stunning enemy Heroes hit. Punishers prioritize
jumping on enemy Gates, so Heroes cannot bait them in while defending.
Do not stand too close to the Gate or you will get hit by the jump!

sections.title: Core Ability
sections.text:
Every 12 seconds, the Core will spawn 2 volleys of Frozen Orbs that explode,
dealing 5% maximum Health as damage and Rooting enemy Heroes
hit for 1.5 seconds.

sections.title: Win Conditions
sections.text:
To win the game on Infernal Shrines, you should count on
any of the following win conditions:
Map Objective,
Split-push.

sections.title: Tips and Tricks
sections.text:
Use the first Healing Fountain (2-minute cooldown) before 1:00 minute
because the first Objective on this Map activates at 3:00 minutes,
so you will have it back in time for that.
Look at the color of the Shrine or mouseover a Shrine indicator
on the Minimap to see whether the next Punisher will be
a Mortar (orange), Frost (blue), or Arcane (purple) one.
39-ing the Objective (stopping at 39 Guardians killed)
is a strategy used to delay a Punisher spawn when your team
has an advantage and the enemy team
killed little to no Guardians. Use it to wait for allied Heroes
to respawn, for the next Talent Tier to be unlocked, or even
for creating a Talent Tier advantage during the next Objective phase.
Punishers can jump on enemy Gates and Heroes, dealing damage and
Stunning enemy Heroes hit. Punishers prioritize
jumping on enemy Gates, so Heroes cannot bait them in while defending.
Do not stand too close to the Gate or you will get hit by the jump!
Global Heroes should ideally take care
of the lane that is farther away from the next Objective location,
so that they can use their global tool
to quickly join their team during the next Objective phase.
See our Map Guides page for further information »
